name: Passing the Blame
summary: A witness blames the quilboar for stealing the woman's gift and dooming the garden. You are sent north to the Valley of Bones to seek a quilboar of significance at Bristleback Retreat.

sections.title: A Garden in Peril
sections.body: The garden is doomed to die, and the one who saw the theft holds the quilboar responsible. To recover the woman's gift, you are sent north into the Valley of Bones. At Bristleback Retreat, you are to seek out a quilboar of significance.

faq.q: Who says the quilboar stole her gift?
faq.answer: Not the woman herself. A witness who saw the theft with their own eyebulbs blames the quilboar for taking her gift.
Head north into the Valley of Bones, to Bristleback Retreat.

faq.q: What am I looking for at Bristleback Retreat?
faq.answer: You are to seek out a quilboar of significance at Bristleback Retreat.

faq.q: Why does the woman blame the quilboar?
faq.answer: The blame comes from a witness, not the woman. The witness says the quilboar stole her gift and are why the garden is doomed to die.
